name: Weekly PACLitaxel + CARBOplatin (anaplastic thyroid carcinoma)
cyclesNote: weekly radiosensitizing / systemic dosing on days 1, 8, 15 of a 21-day cycle; often given concurrent with external-beam radiation for local control

institution.provenance: ONCOTREE draft protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

histology: anaplastic (undifferentiated) thyroid carcinoma, BRAF wild-type without an actionable driver

premedications.name: Taxane hypersensitivity prophylaxis
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 / H2 antihistamine before paclitaxel per standard practice.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin is moderately emetogenic; give per the standard emetic-risk framework.

supportiveCare: assess febrile-neutropenia risk; support with growth factors if indicated, especially during concurrent radiation.
monitor for peripheral neuropathy (paclitaxel), myelosuppression, and carboplatin hypersensitivity on later cycles.
clinical trial is preferred where available; airway and symptom management throughout.
prefer this only for fit patients seeking local control; otherwise best supportive / palliative care.
monitoring: clinical and cross-sectional imaging response assessment

doseModificationRules.condition: ANC < 1000 or platelets < 100k on a treatment day
doseModificationRules.text: Hold that weekly dose and reassess; reduce for recurrent cytopenias or grade 3 to 4 neuropathy per standard practice. Physician decides.

drugs.name: PACLitaxel
drugs.notes: PACLitaxel 60 mg/m2 IV weekly on days 1, 8, 15 as a radiosensitizing / systemic dose for anaplastic thyroid carcinoma (per standard guidelines / general reference; weekly taxane schedules ~50 to 90 mg/m2 are used, higher single-agent doses when not concurrent with radiation). Own wording - not a verbatim source copy.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin
drugs.notes: CARBOplatin AUC 2 IV weekly on days 1, 8, 15 (Calvert formula), paired with weekly paclitaxel for anaplastic thyroid carcinoma, commonly concurrent with external-beam radiation (per standard guidelines / general reference). An every-3-week AUC 5 to 6 schedule is an alternative when not radiosensitizing. Own wording - not a verbatim source copy.
